_comment: Expected PB-007 fill for case.expanded.json. appointment_level=expanded path — limited_* and standard_* fields are null; the full expanded_* set is populated.

_writable_when_branching.appointment_level=limited: NOT triggered — limited_* fields stay null
_writable_when_branching.appointment_level=standard: NOT triggered — standard_* fields stay null

fields.case_title: In re Guardianship of M.K.B. and J.E.B. (Minors)
fields.minor_children_names: Maya K. Brennan (DOB 2011-04-18); Jacob E. Brennan (DOB 2014-07-09)
fields.good_cause_findings: Disputed allegations of substance abuse and educational neglect on both sides; concurrent family-court proceeding; two minors in different schools. Court finds that an expanded-scope GAL with subpoena power and authority to engage evaluators is necessary under 18-C § 1-115 to assess the children's best interests.
fields.objecting_parties_appointment: Father (Christopher Brennan) objects to the appointment of D. Whitten specifically due to a prior matter; objection overruled at the appointment hearing on 2026-05-09.
fields.appointment_factors: Court finds that D. Whitten has no actual conflict; the prior matter (closed 2021) does not bear on the current case.
fields.objecting_parties_fee: Father objects to bearing 50% of the fee; objection overruled — court allocates 75% petitioner / 25% father based on assets and income.
fields.fee_factors: Cap of 60 hours reflects expanded scope (subpoena work, two record-review subjects, evaluator engagement, mediation appearance).
fields.expanded_duties: Interview both minors separately, both petitioners, the father, and the minors' current teachers. Review school records from Portland Public Schools (Maya) and Cape Elizabeth Public Schools (Jacob) for the past 3 academic years. Review the father's substance-abuse treatment records from Day One Recovery (with consent or subpoena). Engage a licensed psychologist to evaluate both minors' attachment to each potential caretaker. Arrange family counseling for the children if necessary. File a written report 60 days before the contested hearing.
fields.expanded_interview_details: Interview Maya's 5th-grade teacher (Ms. Linda Park, Portland Reiche Elementary) and Jacob's 2nd-grade teacher (Mr. Roberto Diaz, Cape Elizabeth Pond Cove Elementary).
fields.expanded_review_records_1: Portland Public Schools records for Maya K. Brennan, AY 2023-2026.
fields.expanded_review_records_2: Cape Elizabeth Public Schools records for Jacob E. Brennan, AY 2023-2026.
fields.expanded_review_records_3: Day One Recovery treatment records for Christopher Brennan, 2024-present.
fields.expanded_evaluation_subject: Both minors' attachment to each potential caretaker; current developmental and emotional functioning.
fields.expanded_counseling_children: Both minors — bi-weekly sessions through report-filing date.
fields.expanded_contact_person: Dr. Sarah Lin (psychologist) — initial intake by 2026-05-30.
fields.expanded_other_duties: Coordinate with the district-court FM matter's GAL (if appointed) to avoid duplicate interviews of the children.

_validator_expectations.what would fail: if the LLM populated limited_duties or standard_other_provisions while appointment_level='expanded', validator would flag `not_writable` for each one — the cascade-catch that proves writability gating works
